card.name: Linking words before southeastern European places
card.fires_on: Small linking words (from, of, between, to, 's) right before a place name in southern or eastern Europe, mostly in historical or geographic text about the Balkans, Hungary, Italy or Spain.

modes.label: Direction or location words
modes.description: Words like from, of or between after a compass direction or region, before a Balkan or Mediterranean place.
modes.example: Mecsek is the southernmost Hungarian mountain range, located north<< from>> Pécs

modes.label: Origin links before town names
modes.description: The word of between a person or title and a town in southern Europe.
modes.example: Ubaydal Allepus<< of>> Bétera, is described as "

modes.label: Military movement in the Balkans
modes.description: Verbs or prepositions in war history that come before places in the region.
modes.example: Capello requested permission to withdraw back<< to>> the Tagliamento.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward Greek, Albanian, Armenian and Mediterranean place names, and away from German or Western European ones.
card.plain: It fires on little linking words when a southeastern European place name is likely to come next.
